data.name: Foxglove Cottage
data.description: Tucked away in the tranquil surroundings of Home Farm in Hamptworth, Foxglove Cottage offers a charming countryside escape on the edge of the enchanting New Forest. One of five beautifully converted barn cottages, it effortlessly blends rustic character with modern comforts, creating a peaceful haven where guests can slow down, relax and reconnect.
data.property_details_html:
Welcome to Foxglove Cottage, a beautifully restored single-storey barn conversion set within the peaceful private grounds of Home Farm in Hamptworth, right on the doorstep of the New Forest National Park.
 

The cottage combines rustic charm with modern luxury, featuring beautiful vaulted ceilings and original exposed wooden beams. Inside, you’ll find a bright open-plan living and dining area with comfortable seating, soft ambient lighting, and a large smart TV for relaxing evenings.
 

The adjoining Shaker-style kitchen is finished in a soft sage green and is fully equipped with premium appliances, including an induction hob, electric oven, dishwasher, washing machine/dryer, microwave, and Nespresso coffee machine. There is also a solid wood dining table with seating for up to four guests.

Both bedrooms are located on the ground floor and offer step-free accessibility.
 

Principal Bedroom: A luxurious 6ft super-king bed, which can be separated into two 3ft single beds upon request. The room also features Egyptian cotton bedding, fitted wardrobe storage, and beautiful exposed oak beams.
 

Second Bedroom: Two comfortable 3ft single beds, which can also be configured as a king-size bed. This room is ideal for children or friends.

Family Bathroom: A stylish modern bathroom with a full-size bathtub, overhead power shower, glass shower screen, illuminated vanity mirror, and heated chrome towel rail.

French doors open onto the shared landscaped central courtyard, where guests have dedicated outdoor seating. It’s a lovely spot to enjoy a morning coffee or an evening drink while listening to the birdsong.

data.surroundings_html:
Information correct at the time of writing:-

The cottages at Home Farm are conveniently located on the border with Wiltshire and Hampshire, so there are lots of opportunities for things to do and days out.

Enjoy the facilities at Hamptworth Golf & Country Club, including: Championship golf course, Padel courts, Pickleball courts, Croquet, Clubhouse, restaurant and bar.

Explore the New Forest National Park - walk or cycle through ancient woodland, heathland and open moorland - spot the famous free-roaming ponies, cattle and deer. Visit charming villages, traditional pubs and farm shops. Enjoy picnics, nature trails and scenic viewpoints.

Discover Salisbury & its history - visit Salisbury Cathedral, home to the tallest church spire in Britain, and one of the best-preserved original copies of the Magna Carta - Visit Mompesson House, wander Salisbury's independent shops, cafes and restaurants or explore Old Sarum, one of southern England's most important historic sites, with its impressive ancient earthworks and panoramic views.

Discover Wiltshire's World Heritage Sites - visit the iconic Stonehenge, and explore Avebury, home to the world's largest prehistoric stone circle, and discover the rich ancient history that makes this UNESCO World Heritage landscape so special.

Take a trip to Shaftesbury and see the famous Gold Hill, featured in the classic Hovis advert.

For gardens, heritage & historic houses visit the magnificent gardens at Stourhead, explore the picturesque village and historic buildings of Lacock Abbey, and wander the beautiful rose gardens and grounds at Mottisfont.
